name: MCIF: Multimodal Crosslingual Instruction-Following Benchmark
description: The first crosslingual human-annotated benchmark based on scientific talks, evaluating multimodal large language models on instruction following across speech, vision, and text modalities in four languages. It spans four macro-tasks: recognition, translation, question answering, and summarization, with both short- and long-form inputs.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that is still emerging, with limited but growing attention in the multimodal and crosslingual MLLM community.
notes: Covers three core modalities and four languages with fully aligned parallel design; released under CC-BY 4.0 license.
